dramatic_structure.goal: make mutual awareness legible through distance without physical contact
dramatic_structure.obstacle: both people avoid acknowledging the changed relationship
dramatic_structure.subtext: the maintained gap carries the tension
dramatic_structure.tactic_change: parallel work becomes a shared pause

locked_facts.value: The two designers are former romantic partners, and their agreed no-contact distance during the joint model review is a relationship-relevant story fact.
They approach opposite sides of the model table and stop within arm's reach.
The table remains between them and neither person touches the other.
The approach and stop occur in one continuous present-time interval without ellipsis.
